title: PENREC reusable artist music-generation prompt profiles

usage: Use original_style_prompt when recovered and verified.
All current profiles are incomplete; fragments are identity constraints, not full generation prompts.
Keep exact source wording in original_style_prompt and exact member wording in vocal_definition; record subsequent adaptations separately.
Do not infer voice configuration, genre, nationality or production from an artist's name.
Add other recently developed artists only when reliable identity/prompt sources are recovered.
